name: ga_clinic_rates
description: Georgia MEDICAID (not Medicare) FQHC (federally qualified health center) and rural health clinic (RHC: freestanding, hospital-based, critical-access) PPS per-visit rates, PER MEDICAID PROVIDER ID and federal fiscal year, from the Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH). Lists carry only the provider ID and the rate: no clinic names or addresses, and none are guessed. Look up one ID (shows its rate in every year held), or browse a program and year, or filter by rate range. Not a per-procedure fee schedule. An unmatched filter returns similar IDs or the valid values.

provider_id.description: Medicaid provider ID as a string, e.g. "003140498A"; a 9-digit prefix matches every suffix. Leading zeros matter.

program.description: FQHC, FS_RHC (freestanding RHC), HB_RHC (hospital-based RHC), CAH_RHC (critical-access RHC), or "all" (default).

ffy.description: Federal fiscal year, e.g. "2027" (1 Oct 2026 to 30 Sep 2027), or "all". Default: newest year when browsing, every year when provider_id is given.

min_rate.description: Only rates at or above this many dollars per visit.

max_rate.description: Only rates at or below this many dollars per visit.

limit.description: Max rows (default 25, max 200). Summaries cover every match.

name: ga_rate_summary
description: Georgia Medicaid FQHC and rural health clinic PPS rate lists at a glance (Georgia Department of Community Health): which lists exist for each federal fiscal year, how many provider IDs each carries, min/median/max/mean per-visit rate, optionally grouped by program or fiscal year. States what the lists do not contain (clinic names) and the date the newest lists were posted.

program.description: One program, or omit for all four.

ffy.description: Federal fiscal year, e.g. "2026", or "all". Default: newest.
